topics.title: Canada and U.S. trade talks break down
topics.summary: Canada says it will answer new U.S. tariffs dollar for dollar after last-minute trade talks collapsed, putting more pressure on businesses and cross-border supply chains.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the studio had to negotiate a tense deal, who would bring charts, who would bring snacks, and who would accidentally make it personal?

topics.title: Lunar eclipse lines up for the Americas
topics.summary: A deep partial lunar eclipse is coming, with the Americas in the best viewing position as most of the moon passes through Earth's shadow.
topics.discussionPrompt: Who would plan a moon-watching party properly, and who would show up with a telescope they definitely do not know how to use?

topics.title: Markets keep watching tariff fallout
topics.summary: Investors are watching tariffs, bond yields, and global growth worries as trade tensions add uncertainty for companies planning prices, hiring, and supply chains.
topics.discussionPrompt: If every studio expense suddenly got harder to predict, who would build a spreadsheet, and who would suggest a bake sale first?

topics.title: Hollywood creatives train AI tools
topics.summary: Some writers, directors, and producers are taking paid gigs training AI systems, even as many worry those tools could shrink future creative work.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the studio had to teach an AI comedy timing, who would over-explain the joke, and who would refuse on principle?

topics.title: Sicily bridge dream keeps stalling
topics.summary: Italy's long-debated plan to connect Sicily to the mainland faces engineering doubts, environmental concerns, cost scrutiny, and local protests.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the studio proposed a giant bridge project, who would love the ambition, and who would immediately ask about maintenance and parking?
